title: Spicy Mexican Sour Noodles
description: A twist on traditional pasta, this spicy Mexican sour noodles dish combines the tanginess of soured cream with the heat of jalapenos.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and set them aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped jalapenos and cook until they start to soften.
Add the Mexican seasoning, cumin, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sour cream to the skillet and stir until it starts to thicken.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sour cream mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Serve the spicy Mexican sour noodles hot.
